metadata.title: Global Data Standard Metrics
metadata.scope: All data assets, data products, pipelines, models, AI agents, multi-agent swarms, digital twins, vector/embedding stores, test data estates, data spaces, supply chains, visualizations, and monetization streams across all industries, jurisdictions, and ecosystem boundaries.
metadata.north_star: Global Data Excellence Index (GDEI) >= 90 with zero Tier-1 critical breaches and verified Data Supply Chain Resilience Index (DSCRI) >= 85.
metadata.governing_philosophy: A universal, rigorous, and actionable framework for measuring, managing, and maximizing the value, integrity, security, sustainability, resilience, and trustworthiness of data assets across all global industries and ecosystem boundaries, aligned with FAIR/CARE principles and modern data paradigms (Data Mesh, Data Fabric, Data Contracts, Data Spaces, Agentic & Multi-Agent AI, Digital Twins, Federated Learning, Post-Quantum Readiness).
aligned_frameworks: EDM Council DCAM & CDMC (Data Management Capabilities)
ISO 8000 (Data Quality), ISO 27001/27701/27017/27018 (InfoSec & Privacy), ISO 5259 (AI Data Quality), ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Management), ISO 23894 (AI Risk)
ISO 15489 (Records Management), ISO 20917 (Test Data), ISO 8000-170 (Master Data)
NIST CSF 2.0, NIST AI RMF 1.0 & 1.1, NIST SP 800-207 (Zero Trust), NIST SP 800-161 (Hardware Supply Chain)
NIST FIPS 203/204/205 (Post-Quantum Cryptography), NIST IR 8374 (Cryptographic Agility)
SLSA (Supply-chain Levels for Software Artifacts) adapted for Data
W3C WCAG 2.2, W3C DCAT, W3C SKOS/OWL, W3C Data Spaces CG
FAIR & CARE Data Principles, OpenLineage, Open Data Contract Standard (ODCS) 2.x
Google SRE (SLO/Error Budget model), DORA delivery metrics, Team Topologies
Green Software Foundation (SCI), GHG Protocol Scope 1-3, ISO 14064/50001, Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi)
EU AI Act (enforcement from Aug 2026), EU Data Act, EU Data Governance Act, GDPR/CPRA, China PIPL, India DPDP Act 2023, Brazil LGPD, OECD AI Principles
Gaia-X, International Data Spaces (IDSA) Reference Architecture, DSSC (Data Spaces Support Centre)
OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications v1.5, MITRE ATLAS, NIST SP 800-218 (Secure Software Development) adapted for data
FinOps Framework & FOCUS 1.2, TCFD/ISSB IFRS S2 (Climate Data), SASB
IEC 62443 (Industrial Security), ISA-95, OPC UA, ISO 23247 (Digital Twin Manufacturing)
NERC CIP (Energy), 3GPP & TM Forum Open Digital Framework (Telecom), ITAR/EAR (Defense)

conformance_profiles.description: Sector overlays that elevate specific domains and add mandatory standards. All profiles inherit the full base standard.

healthcare_life_sciences.special_requirements: ALCOA+ attribution must be cryptographically verifiable for clinical trial data.

public_sector.special_requirements: CARE Principles for Indigenous Data mandatory for any data involving indigenous populations.

retail_ecommerce.special_requirements: Customer data portability (GDPR Art. 20) must be executable within 30 days in machine-readable format.

manufacturing_iot.special_requirements: Digital twin synchronization lag (DTW-01) must not exceed physical process safety thresholds.

energy_utilities.special_requirements: Grid-critical data products require 99.999% availability SLO; cascade failure containment (DRI-07) is mandatory Tier 1.

telecommunications.special_requirements: Streaming data quality (DQO-08) at sub-second latency for network telemetry; roaming data subject to multiple jurisdictional overlays.

defense_aerospace.special_requirements: Cross-border transfer (DSP-10) is prohibited for ITAR-controlled data without DDTC authorization; supply chain (DSC) metrics are elevated to Tier 1.

transportation_logistics.special_requirements: Cross-organizational interoperability (ECO-02) with customs, carriers, and ports is Tier 1.

cross_cutting_principles.enforcement: DSP domain; DCO-01 contracts embed classification; DLR-04 minimization; DSP-09 purpose limitation
AAG and GEN domains; AAG-06/07, GEN-01/04/07/08
DSP-02 residency; DSP-10 cross-border; CARE Principles embedded in DSP-04, DMV-04, ECO-03

cross_cutting_principles.principle: Zero Trust Architecture for Data Access

cross_cutting_principles.enforcement: SGO domain; SGO-04/05/07/08 feed procurement decisions; Science-Based Targets alignment
All metrics conform to metric_schema; GEN-01, DLR-05, DSC-05, anti-gaming provisions
DSC domain; SLSA-for-data model; DSC-01/03/05 mandatory for all ingested third-party data
DSP-04 advanced encryption; DSC-04 PQC readiness; crypto-inventory with algorithm agility
ECO and MET domains; Gaia-X/IDSA conformance; DCAT federation; semantic alignment across trust boundaries
DVE domain; DVE-03 extended to cognitive load; WCAG 2.2 AAA plus neurodiversity heuristics
GEN-07/08; agent-to-agent contracts; tool-use allowlists; cascade-failure isolation

metric_schema.description: Canonical schema. Every metric in this standard conforms to these fields, ensuring comparability, automation-readiness, and auditability. All metrics in this document have lifecycle_status = ACTIVE unless marked otherwise.

field_definitions.metric_id: Immutable identifier: <domain prefix>-<sequence>. Never reused, even after retirement.
field_definitions.metric_tier: Tier 1 = Strategic/Regulatory (board & regulator reporting, mandatory for certification) | Tier 2 = Operational (domain governance councils) | Tier 3 = Diagnostic (team-level optimization).
field_definitions.directionality: higher_is_better | lower_is_better | band (must remain within range).
field_definitions.owner_role: Exactly one accountable role per metric (per RACI); never an ambiguous team.
field_definitions.warning_threshold: Boundary triggering ES2 steward-level intervention before target breach.
field_definitions.critical_threshold: Boundary triggering ES3/ES4 escalation and formal remediation.
field_definitions.measurement_method: Automated (preferred) | Sampled audit | Manual attestation + automated validation.
field_definitions.standard_reference: External standard(s) from which the metric derives authority.
field_definitions.lifecycle_status: PROPOSED -> PILOT -> ACTIVE -> DEPRECATED -> RETIRED. Threshold or formula changes require council approval and version increment.
field_definitions.quantum_readiness_tag: CRYPTO_CLASSICAL | CRYPTO_HYBRID | CRYPTO_PQC_READY - indicates cryptographic posture of any metric relying on cryptographic controls.
field_definitions.ecoscope_scope: Scope 1 (internal) | Scope 2 (direct ecosystem partners) | Scope 3 (extended supply chain) - for metrics with ecosystem boundary implications.

tier_reporting_cadence.Tier 1: Monthly to Data Governance Council; quarterly to Board/Regulators.
tier_reporting_cadence.Tier 2: Monthly within domain councils; summarized quarterly.

data_quality_and_observability.description: Measures fitness, reliability, and systemic health of data throughout its lifecycle, extending beyond static quality to continuous observability across batch, streaming, and vector modalities.
typical_instrumentation: Declarative testing (dbt tests, Great Expectations, Soda)
data_quality_and_observability.domain_score_formula: Weighted mean of metric attainment (Tier weights T1=3, T2=2, T3=1), scaled 0-100.

metrics.name: Automated Data Observability Health Score
metrics.definition: Composite score across the five observability pillars: freshness, distribution, volume, schema, and lineage integrity.
metrics.formula: 0.20*Freshness + 0.20*Volume + 0.20*Distribution + 0.20*Schema + 0.20*Lineage Integrity (each pillar normalized 0-100)

metrics.name: Semantic Consistency Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of data elements conforming to the enterprise business glossary and ontological definitions.
metrics.formula: (Fields mapped to approved glossary terms / Total critical data fields) * 100

metrics.name: Data Lineage Completeness
metrics.definition: Percentage of critical data elements (CDEs) with fully documented, automated, end-to-end lineage from source to consumption, including row-level lineage for regulated domains.
metrics.formula: (CDEs with end-to-end lineage / Total CDEs) * 100
metrics.breach_escalation: ES3 if CDEs in regulated domains

metrics.name: Data Freshness SLA Adherence
metrics.definition: Percentage of datasets delivered within their contracted freshness SLA (time since last successful update).
metrics.formula: (Datasets meeting contracted freshness SLA / Datasets with freshness SLA) * 100

metrics.name: Automated Validation Rule Pass Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of executed data quality validation rules (not-null, range, referential, business rules) that pass.
metrics.formula: (Passed validation rule executions / Total validation rule executions) * 100 over rolling 7-day window

metrics.name: Anomaly Detection Coverage
metrics.definition: Percentage of critical pipelines and datasets monitored by automated anomaly detection spanning all five observability pillars.
metrics.formula: (Critical pipelines with full anomaly detection coverage / Total critical pipelines) * 100

metrics.name: Data Quality Issue MTTR
metrics.definition: Mean time from detection to verified remediation of P1/P2 data quality incidents.
metrics.formula: Sum(detection to verified-resolution time) / Number of resolved P1/P2 DQ incidents

metrics.name: Streaming Data Integrity (Jitter & Latency Variance)
metrics.definition: Percentage of streaming events delivered within contracted latency bounds with inter-arrival jitter below threshold, for real-time data products.
metrics.formula: (Streaming events meeting latency + jitter SLO / Total streaming events) * 100 over rolling 1-hour window

data_security_privacy_and_sovereignty.description: Ensures protection, ethical handling, and jurisdictional compliance of data, upholding the CIA triad, modern privacy rights, verifiable accountability, and cryptographic agility toward post-quantum readiness.
data_security_privacy_and_sovereignty.domain_score_formula: Weighted mean of metric attainment (Tier weights T1=3, T2=2, T3=1), scaled 0-100.

metrics.name: Zero Trust Data Access Compliance
metrics.definition: Percentage of data access requests validated through continuous, context-aware authentication and least-privilege authorization.
metrics.formula: (Context-validated access requests / Total access requests) * 100

metrics.name: Data Residency & Sovereignty Adherence
metrics.definition: Percentage of data stored and processed strictly within legally mandated geographic or jurisdictional boundaries.
metrics.formula: (Regulated data volume compliant with residency rules / Total regulated data volume) * 100
standard_reference: CARE Principles for Indigenous Data Governance

metrics.name: Right to Be Forgotten (RTBF) Fulfillment Time
metrics.definition: Average time to completely erase or anonymize a data subject's information across all systems upon verified request.
metrics.formula: Sum(fulfillment time per request) / Total RTBF requests
metrics.critical_threshold: > 96 hours or any statutory deadline miss

metrics.name: Advanced Encryption Coverage
metrics.definition: Percentage of highly sensitive data protected by advanced cryptography (AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit, confidential computing or homomorphic encryption in processing).
metrics.formula: (Sensitive data volume under advanced encryption / Total sensitive data volume) * 100
metrics.measurement_method: Automated - KMS and storage configuration audit

metrics.name: Sensitive Data Classification Coverage
metrics.definition: Percentage of all data assets carrying a verified, current sensitivity classification (including PII flags) in the catalog.
metrics.formula: (Data volume with verified current classification / Total data volume) * 100

metrics.name: Least-Privilege Drift Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of active access grants exceeding the least-privilege baseline for the role and data classification.
metrics.formula: (Access grants exceeding least-privilege baseline / Total active access grants) * 100

metrics.name: Breach Notification Timeliness
metrics.definition: Percentage of qualifying security/privacy incidents notified to regulators and affected parties within the statutory window (e.g., 72 hours under GDPR).
metrics.formula: (Incidents notified within statutory window / Total qualifying incidents) * 100

metrics.name: Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) Readiness Index
metrics.definition: Percentage of cryptographic assets (keys, certificates, TLS endpoints) inventoried, assessed for quantum vulnerability, and either migrated to NIST PQC algorithms (ML-KEM/ML-DSA/SLH-DSA per FIPS 203/204/205) or operating in hybrid mode.
metrics.formula: (Crypto assets in PQC-ready or hybrid mode / Total crypto assets in inventory) * 100

metrics.name: Consent Granularity & Purpose Limitation Conformance
metrics.definition: Percentage of personal data processing operations backed by granular, auditable consent records that specify purpose, legal basis, retention, and third-party sharing, with no purpose drift detected.
metrics.formula: (Processing operations with compliant granular consent / Total personal data processing operations) * 100
metrics.measurement_method: Automated - consent platform reconciliation + processing activity audit
metrics.breach_escalation: ES3 (ES4 if purpose drift involves special-category data)

metrics.name: Cross-Border Transfer Mechanism Coverage
metrics.definition: Percentage of cross-border personal data transfers covered by an adequate legal mechanism (adequacy decision, SCCs, BCRs, derogations) with Transfer Impact Assessment (TIA) on file.
metrics.formula: (Transfers with valid mechanism + TIA / Total cross-border transfers) * 100

data_visualization_and_experience.description: Standards for representing data graphically to communicate clearly, truthfully, efficiently, and universally accessibly, including cognitive and neurodiverse accessibility.
data_visualization_and_experience.domain_score_formula: Weighted mean of metric attainment (Tier weights T1=3, T2=2, T3=1), scaled 0-100.

metrics.name: Universal Accessibility Conformance
metrics.definition: Degree to which dashboards and visualizations meet stringent accessibility standards for users with disabilities, including WCAG 2.2 Level AAA plus cognitive/neurodiversity heuristics.
metrics.formula: (Passed WCAG 2.2 Level AAA criteria + cognitive heuristics / Total applicable criteria) * 100 (Level AA is a mandatory release gate)
standard_reference: Cognitive Accessibility W3C Working Group Notes

metrics.name: Visual Misrepresentation Index
metrics.definition: Penalty score for deceptive visualization practices (truncated axes without disclosure, misleading aspect ratios, inappropriate chart types).
metrics.formula: Sum of weighted anti-pattern detections per dashboard (lower is better)

metrics.name: Time-to-Insight (Cognitive Load)
metrics.definition: Average time for a target user to correctly interpret the primary actionable message of a dashboard without external explanation, inclusive of neurodiverse user cohorts.
metrics.formula: Sum(user interpretation time) / Number of users tested (stratified by neurotype where consented)
metrics.target_threshold: <= 8 seconds for primary KPIs; variance across neurotypes < 25%
metrics.measurement_method: Sampled audit - moderated testing with neurodiverse panel

metrics.name: KPI Definition Consistency Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of enterprise KPIs rendered from a single governed definition (semantic layer or certified metric object) across all dashboards.
metrics.formula: (KPIs with single governed definition / Total KPIs in production) * 100

metrics.name: Certified Dashboard Ratio
metrics.definition: Percentage of published dashboards that carry current certification (verified sources, owner, accessibility pass, misrepresentation check).
metrics.formula: (Certified dashboards / Total published dashboards) * 100

metrics.name: Dashboard Adoption Rate
metrics.definition: Monthly active users of a dashboard as a share of its intended audience.
metrics.formula: (Monthly active users / Intended audience) * 100

advanced_analytics_and_ai_governance.description: Standards for extracting meaningful, statistically rigorous, and ethically sound insights from ML, GenAI, federated learning, and advanced analytics, including adversarial robustness and environmental footprint.
typical_instrumentation: ML metadata stores (MLflow, managed cloud equivalents)
advanced_analytics_and_ai_governance.domain_score_formula: Weighted mean of metric attainment (Tier weights T1=3, T2=2, T3=1), scaled 0-100.

metrics.name: AI Training Data Provenance Score
metrics.definition: Percentage of training data for ML/GenAI models with verified consent, copyright clearance, and lineage.
metrics.formula: (Fully provenanced training data volume / Total training data volume) * 100

metrics.name: Algorithmic Fairness Disparity Ratio
metrics.definition: Disparate impact across protected demographic groups in predictive or generative AI outcomes.
metrics.formula: Favorable outcome rate (unprivileged group) / Favorable outcome rate (privileged group)

metrics.name: Analytical Reproducibility Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of analyses/models independently replicable with the same data, code, and containerized environment yielding identical results.
metrics.formula: (Reproducible analyses / Total analyses audited) * 100

metrics.name: Synthetic Data Fidelity & Utility Score
metrics.definition: How well synthetic data preserves statistical properties and utility of the original data without PII leakage.
metrics.formula: Weighted average(statistical similarity, ML utility) - privacy leakage risk penalty

metrics.name: Model Drift Detection Coverage
metrics.definition: Percentage of production models with automated data-drift and concept-drift monitoring and alerting.
metrics.formula: (Production models with automated drift monitoring / Total production models) * 100; high-risk models require 100%

metrics.name: Explainability Coverage
metrics.definition: Percentage of high-risk AI system decisions accompanied by compliant, stakeholder-appropriate explanations (global and local).
metrics.formula: (High-risk decisions with compliant explanations / Total high-risk decisions sampled) * 100
metrics.measurement_method: Automated - explanation generation coverage + sampled audit

metrics.name: Human Oversight Coverage
metrics.definition: Percentage of high-risk AI decisions subject to meaningful human review with authority and competence to intervene (EU AI Act Art. 14).
metrics.formula: (High-risk decisions under effective human oversight / Total high-risk decisions) * 100

metrics.name: Federated Learning Integrity Score
metrics.definition: Percentage of federated learning rounds with verified model aggregation integrity, poisoning-attack resistance, and differential-privacy guarantees honored.
metrics.formula: (Federated rounds passing integrity + DP + poisoning checks / Total federated rounds) * 100
metrics.owner_role: Head of Data Science with CISO
metrics.measurement_method: Automated - FL orchestrator telemetry + cryptographic attestation

metrics.name: Adversarial Robustness Score
metrics.definition: Percentage of production ML models passing adversarial robustness evaluation (e.g., PGD, FGSM, adversarial patch) at contracted perturbation budgets.
metrics.formula: (Models passing adversarial test suite at contracted budget / Total production models subject to adversarial testing) * 100
metrics.measurement_method: Automated - adversarial test harness (CleverHans, ART, RobustBench)

metrics.name: Model Inference Carbon Footprint per Prediction
metrics.definition: Grams of CO2-equivalent emitted per 1,000 model inference calls, measured across the full compute stack.
metrics.formula: Total CO2e from inference compute / (Total inference calls / 1000)
metrics.owner_role: Green Data / Sustainability Lead with MLOps
metrics.critical_threshold: Any year-over-year increase without documented workload growth justification

data_monetization_and_value_realization.description: Frameworks for measuring financial, strategic, and societal value generated from data assets, ensuring ethical, scalable, product-centric approaches including data portability and marketplace exchanges.
data_monetization_and_value_realization.domain_score_formula: Weighted mean of metric attainment (Tier weights T1=3, T2=2, T3=1), scaled 0-100.

metrics.name: Return on Data Asset (RODA)
metrics.definition: Net financial benefit of a data asset or product relative to its total cost of ownership (storage, compute, governance, people).
metrics.formula: ((Net revenue from data + quantified cost savings) - Total data TCO) / Total data TCO * 100

metrics.name: Data Product Active Adoption Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of target internal or external users actively consuming a data product, API, or dashboard within a defined period.
metrics.formula: (Active unique consumers / Total addressable consumers) * 100

metrics.name: Unit Cost of Data Delivery
metrics.definition: Fully loaded infrastructure and operational cost to serve a single data query, API call, or batch delivery.
metrics.formula: Total monthly data platform cost / Total queries or deliveries

metrics.name: Ethical Monetization Compliance Score
metrics.definition: Audit score ensuring data monetization or sharing does not violate user consent, privacy law, or equitable data-sharing principles.
metrics.formula: (Fully compliant monetization streams / Total monetization streams) * 100

metrics.name: Data Product SLA Attainment
metrics.definition: Percentage of data products meeting published consumer SLAs (freshness, availability, support response, accuracy).
metrics.formula: (Data product-months meeting all published SLAs / Total data product-months) * 100

metrics.name: Data Asset Reuse Ratio
metrics.definition: Percentage of data products consumed by two or more distinct business domains, indicating composability and ROI leverage.
metrics.formula: (Data products with >= 2 consuming domains / Total data products) * 100

metrics.name: Value Attribution Confidence
metrics.definition: Percentage of reported data value claims backed by an auditable measurement methodology and independent validation (anti-gaming control).
metrics.formula: (Value claims with auditable validated methodology / Total reported value claims) * 100

metrics.name: Data Portability Fulfillment Time
metrics.definition: Median time to deliver a complete, machine-readable, structured export of a data subject's personal data upon request, in a commonly-used format (JSON, CSV, RDF).
metrics.formula: Median(fulfillment timestamp - request timestamp) for portability requests
metrics.critical_threshold: > 168 hours or any statutory deadline miss

metrics.name: Data Marketplace Transaction Success Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of external data marketplace transactions (data product sales, API subscriptions, data-sharing agreements) completed without contractual, technical, or compliance failure.
metrics.formula: (Successful marketplace transactions / Total marketplace transactions attempted) * 100

metadata_and_interoperability.description: Standards ensuring data is discoverable, well-documented, current, and seamlessly exchangeable across heterogeneous systems, organizational boundaries, and data spaces.
metadata_and_interoperability.domain_score_formula: Weighted mean of metric attainment (Tier weights T1=3, T2=2, T3=1), scaled 0-100.

metrics.name: Data Catalog Coverage Ratio
metrics.definition: Percentage of all enterprise data sources registered and indexed in the central data catalog.
metrics.formula: (Registered data sources / Total known data sources) * 100

metrics.name: Metadata Richness Score
metrics.definition: Average proportion of mandatory metadata attributes (owner, classification, glossary term, lineage, PII flag) populated per critical data element.
metrics.formula: (Populated mandatory metadata fields / (Total CDEs * mandatory field count)) * 100

metrics.name: Cross-Domain Interoperability Success Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of data exchange transactions between disparate systems or organizations succeeding without schema or semantic mapping errors.
metrics.formula: (Successful interoperable exchanges / Total exchange attempts) * 100

metrics.name: Machine-Readable Metadata Conformance
metrics.definition: Percentage of cataloged assets exposing valid, standards-compliant machine-readable metadata (DCAT/JSON-LD) for automated discovery and exchange.
metrics.formula: (Assets with valid DCAT-conformant metadata export / Total cataloged assets) * 100
metrics.measurement_method: Automated - schema validation of metadata exports

metrics.name: Metadata Freshness Lag
metrics.definition: Median time between a source schema or ownership change and its reflection in catalog metadata.
metrics.formula: Median(propagation timestamp delta across all metadata update events)

metrics.name: Mean Time to Discover
metrics.definition: Median time for an authorized user to locate and submit access for a needed dataset via the catalog and self-service workflow.
metrics.formula: Median(discovery-to-request submission time across sampled sessions)
metrics.measurement_method: Sampled audit - session telemetry + user testing

metrics.name: Data Space Connector Conformance
metrics.definition: Percentage of ecosystem data exchanges conducted through certified data space connectors (Gaia-X Self-Descriptions, IDSA Connector, DSSC-compliant) with verifiable usage policies.
metrics.formula: (Exchanges via certified connectors / Total ecosystem exchanges) * 100

metrics.name: Ecosystem Metadata Federation Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of cross-organizational data-sharing partners whose metadata catalogs are federated into a common discovery plane with semantic alignment.
metrics.formula: (Federated partners with aligned metadata / Total data-sharing partners) * 100

sustainability_and_green_data_operations.description: Metrics to measure and minimize environmental impact of data storage, processing, transmission, and AI inference, aligned with global climate goals and Science-Based Targets.
sustainability_and_green_data_operations.domain_score_formula: Weighted mean of metric attainment (Tier weights T1=3, T2=2, T3=1), scaled 0-100.

metrics.name: Carbon Intensity of Data Processing
metrics.definition: CO2-equivalent emissions generated per unit of data processed or queried.
metrics.formula: Total CO2e from data infrastructure / Total data volume processed (TB)

metrics.name: Dark Data Reduction Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of redundant, obsolete, or trivial (ROT) data identified and then archived or deleted to reduce storage footprint.
metrics.formula: (ROT data volume eliminated / Total ROT volume identified) * 100

metrics.name: Renewable-Weighted PUE
metrics.definition: Data center energy efficiency weighted by renewable energy share.
metrics.formula: (Total facility energy / IT equipment energy) weighted by % renewable energy

metrics.name: Compute Utilization Rate
metrics.definition: Average utilization of data platform compute resources (CPU/GPU), exposing idle or oversized provisioning waste.
metrics.formula: (Allocated compute actually used / Total allocated compute) * 100 over billing period

metrics.name: Carbon-Aware Scheduling Coverage
metrics.definition: Percentage of flexible (non-latency-sensitive) batch and training workloads scheduled using grid carbon-intensity signals.
metrics.formula: (Flexible workloads under carbon-aware scheduling / Total flexible workloads) * 100

metrics.name: E-Waste Stewardship Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of decommissioned data hardware processed through certified responsible recycling or refurbishment channels.
metrics.formula: (Hardware decommissioned via certified channels / Total hardware decommissioned) * 100

metrics.name: Model Training Carbon Budget Adherence
metrics.definition: Percentage of large-scale model training runs that complete within their pre-approved carbon budget (measured in kgCO2e).
metrics.formula: (Training runs within approved carbon budget / Total large-scale training runs) * 100
metrics.owner_role: Head of Data Science with Green Data Lead

metrics.name: Water Usage Effectiveness (WUE)
metrics.definition: Liters of water consumed per kWh of IT energy, measuring data center water stewardship, particularly in water-stressed regions.
metrics.formula: Total annual water consumption (liters) / Total annual IT energy consumption (kWh)
metrics.target_threshold: <= 1.0 L/kWh (industry best practice); < 0.5 in water-stressed basins
metrics.critical_threshold: > 1.8 L/kWh or non-compliance with local water regulations

data_lifecycle_and_retention.description: Governs creation, preservation, legal holds, minimization, purpose limitation, portability, and defensible, auditable disposition of data from cradle to grave.
data_lifecycle_and_retention.domain_score_formula: Weighted mean of metric attainment (Tier weights T1=3, T2=2, T3=1), scaled 0-100.

metrics.name: Retention Schedule Compliance Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of data assets whose current age and storage state conform to the approved retention schedule.
metrics.formula: (Assets within retention schedule conformance / Total assets subject to schedules) * 100

metrics.name: Certified Disposition Execution Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of dispositions (deletions/archivals) due in period that were executed within 30 days with verifiable destruction/archival certificates.
metrics.formula: (Dispositions executed on time with certificates / Dispositions due) * 100
metrics.critical_threshold: < 95.0 or destruction of any legally-held record

metrics.name: Legal Hold Effectiveness
metrics.definition: Percentage of required legal holds applied correctly and within 24 hours, with zero spoliation events.
metrics.formula: (Required holds correctly applied within 24h / Total required holds) * 100; spoliation = automatic critical

metrics.name: Data Minimization Conformance
metrics.definition: Percentage of datasets reviewed within the last 12 months for continued necessity and proportionality of collected fields.
metrics.formula: (Datasets with current minimization review / Total datasets containing personal data) * 100

metrics.name: Lifecycle Chain-of-Custody Auditability
metrics.definition: Percentage of lifecycle events (transfer, transformation, disposition) carrying immutable, tamper-evident proof of custody.
metrics.formula: (Lifecycle events with immutable proof / Total lifecycle events) * 100

metrics.name: Data Portability Execution Time
metrics.definition: Median time to execute a data subject's portability request end-to-end, including data extraction, format conversion, integrity verification, and secure delivery.
metrics.formula: Median(portability execution timestamp - validated request timestamp)
metrics.critical_threshold: > 168 hours or any statutory deadline miss

metrics.name: Purpose Limitation Conformance
metrics.definition: Percentage of data processing operations that remain within their originally declared and consented purpose, with no detected purpose drift.
metrics.formula: (Processing operations with no detected purpose drift / Total processing operations) * 100
metrics.measurement_method: Automated - processing activity monitoring + consent reconciliation

master_and_reference_data.description: Ensures master entities (customer, product, supplier, location) and reference code sets exist once, accurately, and consistently across the enterprise and across enterprise boundaries.
master_and_reference_data.domain_score_formula: Weighted mean of metric attainment (Tier weights T1=3, T2=2, T3=1), scaled 0-100.

metrics.name: Golden Record Accuracy Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of golden records verified correct against authoritative sources via statistically valid sampling.
metrics.formula: (Golden records verified accurate / Golden records sampled) * 100

metrics.name: Duplicate Record Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of master entity records identified as duplicates of an existing golden record.
metrics.formula: (Confirmed duplicate records / Total master records) * 100

metrics.name: Reference Data Conformance Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of transactional records using approved, current reference code sets (country, currency, product, industry codes).
metrics.formula: (Records using approved code sets / Total records consuming reference data) * 100

metrics.name: Cross-System Synchronization Lag
metrics.definition: Median time for a mastered attribute change to propagate to all consuming operational systems.
metrics.formula: Median(propagation timestamp delta across consuming systems)

metrics.name: Master Data Stewardship Coverage
metrics.definition: Percentage of master entities with an assigned accountable steward and published, versioned survivorship rules.
metrics.formula: (Master entities with steward + published survivorship rules / Total master entities) * 100

metrics.name: Cross-Enterprise Entity Resolution Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of B2B partner entity records (customer, supplier, partner) successfully matched and deduplicated across organizational boundaries using agreed semantic keys and privacy-preserving techniques.
metrics.formula: (Partner entities resolved cross-enterprise / Total partner entities subject to resolution) * 100
metrics.owner_role: Ecosystem Integration Lead with MDM Lead

data_reliability_and_incident_management.description: Applies SRE discipline to data: SLOs, error budgets, detection, response, cascade failure containment, and organizational learning from data incidents.
data_reliability_and_incident_management.domain_score_formula: Weighted mean of metric attainment (Tier weights T1=3, T2=2, T3=1), scaled 0-100.

metrics.name: Data Product Availability SLO Attainment
metrics.definition: Percentage of time critical data products are available and serving within their published availability SLO.
metrics.formula: (Time within availability SLO / Total measurement time) * 100

metrics.name: Error Budget Burn Rate
metrics.definition: Ratio of SLO error budget consumed relative to allowed consumption pace; governs change velocity for data products.
metrics.formula: Actual error budget consumption / Allowed consumption for period

metrics.name: Data Incident MTTD
metrics.definition: Mean time to detect P1 data incidents, measuring the effectiveness of automated observability versus human discovery.
metrics.formula: Sum(detection time per P1 incident) / Total P1 incidents

metrics.name: Data Incident MTTR
metrics.definition: Mean time from P1 data incident detection to full service restoration and validation.
metrics.formula: Sum(restoration time per P1 incident) / Total P1 incidents

metrics.name: Blast Radius Containment Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of incidents where all impacted downstream consumers were automatically identified via lineage and notified within 30 minutes.
metrics.formula: (Incidents with automated full-impact notification <= 30 min / Total incidents with downstream impact) * 100

metrics.name: Recurring Incident Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of data incidents whose root cause recurs within 90 days, measuring the quality of post-incident learning.
metrics.formula: (Incidents with repeat root cause within 90 days / Total incidents) * 100

metrics.name: Cascade Failure Containment Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of upstream data failures that are successfully contained (via circuit breakers, bulkheads, fallback data products) without propagating to critical downstream consumers or safety-critical systems.
metrics.formula: (Contained upstream failures / Total upstream failures) * 100
metrics.critical_threshold: < 85.0 or any cascade reaching safety-critical systems

data_contracts_and_dataops.description: Codifies producer-consumer agreements and DataOps engineering discipline: enforced contracts, automated testing, safe change, flow efficiency, and version compatibility.
data_contracts_and_dataops.domain_score_formula: Weighted mean of metric attainment (Tier weights T1=3, T2=2, T3=1), scaled 0-100.

metrics.name: Data Contract Coverage
metrics.definition: Percentage of critical pipelines governed by enforced data contracts specifying schema, quality, SLA, semantics, and ownership.
metrics.formula: (Critical pipelines with enforced contracts / Total critical pipelines) * 100

metrics.name: Contract Gate Pass Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of pipeline changes passing policy-as-code contract validation gates on first attempt in CI/CD.
metrics.formula: (First-pass gate approvals / Total gate executions) * 100

metrics.name: Breaking Change Compliance
metrics.definition: Percentage of breaking schema/semantic changes shipped with at least two release cycles of notice and documented consumer sign-off.
metrics.formula: (Breaking changes with notice + sign-off / Total breaking changes) * 100

metrics.name: Pipeline Test Coverage
metrics.definition: Percentage of critical transformations protected by automated unit and integration tests executed on every change.
metrics.formula: (Critical transformations under automated test / Total critical transformations) * 100

metrics.name: Data Change Lead Time
metrics.definition: Median time from merged code to running in production for data pipeline changes.
metrics.formula: Median(production deployment timestamp - merge timestamp)

metrics.name: Pipeline Deployment Success Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of data pipeline deployments completed without rollback or emergency hotfix.
metrics.formula: (Deployments without rollback / Total deployments) * 100

metrics.name: Contract Version Backward Compatibility
metrics.definition: Percentage of data contract version increments that maintain backward compatibility (additive-only changes) or execute coordinated migrations with consumer sign-off.
metrics.formula: (Backward-compatible or coordinated-migration contract versions / Total contract version increments) * 100

agentic_and_generative_ai_governance.description: Governs autonomous agents, multi-agent swarms, and generative AI: immutable auditability, groundedness, adversarial robustness, autonomy boundaries, tool-use control, agent-to-agent contracts, memory governance, and shadow-AI control.
agentic_and_generative_ai_governance.domain_score_formula: Weighted mean of metric attainment (Tier weights T1=3, T2=2, T3=1), scaled 0-100.

metrics.name: Agent Action Auditability Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of autonomous agent actions recorded in immutable logs capturing input, decision rationale, tools invoked, approvals, and output.
metrics.formula: (Agent actions with complete immutable audit records / Total agent actions) * 100

metrics.name: Generative Output Groundedness Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of GenAI responses verifiably grounded in approved retrieval corpus or system prompts, or explicitly flagged as ungrounded.
metrics.formula: (Grounded or explicitly flagged responses / Total responses sampled) * 100

metrics.name: Prompt-Injection Defense Efficacy
metrics.definition: Percentage of adversarial prompt-injection and jailbreak test cases blocked by layered defenses.
metrics.formula: (Adversarial attacks blocked / Total adversarial test cases) * 100

metrics.name: Autonomy Boundary Adherence
metrics.definition: Percentage of high-stakes agent actions (financial, legal, safety, external communications) executed only with prior human approval.
metrics.formula: (High-stakes actions with valid prior human approval / Total high-stakes agent actions) * 100

metrics.name: RAG Citation Coverage
metrics.definition: Percentage of retrieval-augmented responses containing resolvable citations to authoritative sources.
metrics.formula: (Responses with resolvable citations / Total RAG responses sampled) * 100

metrics.name: Shadow AI Detection & Remediation Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of unauthorized AI tools/models handling enterprise data that are detected and remediated (registered or decommissioned) within 30 days.
metrics.formula: (Unauthorized AI detected and remediated <= 30 days / Total unauthorized AI detected) * 100

metrics.name: Multi-Agent Orchestration Integrity
metrics.definition: Percentage of multi-agent interactions governed by explicit agent-to-agent contracts specifying allowed roles, message schemas, delegation boundaries, and termination conditions.
metrics.formula: (Agent interactions under explicit contracts / Total multi-agent interactions) * 100

metrics.name: Tool-Use Boundary Compliance
metrics.definition: Percentage of agent tool invocations (API calls, code execution, file operations, network access) that conform to the agent's approved tool-allowlist and capability boundary.
metrics.formula: (Tool invocations within approved allowlist / Total tool invocations) * 100

metrics.name: Agent Memory Persistence Governance
metrics.definition: Percentage of agent memory stores (short-term context, long-term memory, episodic memory) with classified sensitivity, retention policy, and access controls aligned to data governance standards.
metrics.formula: (Governed agent memory stores / Total agent memory stores) * 100
metrics.owner_role: AI Ethics & Governance Board with CPO
metrics.critical_threshold: < 90.0 or any unclassified memory containing PII
metrics.measurement_method: Automated - memory store inventory + classification scan

data_literacy_culture_and_workforce.description: Measures the human system: literacy, accountable role coverage, governance responsiveness, elimination of ungoverned shadow practices, ethics board independence, and whistleblower mechanisms.
data_literacy_culture_and_workforce.domain_score_formula: Weighted mean of metric attainment (Tier weights T1=3, T2=2, T3=1), scaled 0-100.

metrics.name: Data Literacy Certification Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of the workforce in data-touching roles holding a current annual data & AI literacy certification.
metrics.formula: (Roles with current certification / Total data-touching roles) * 100

metrics.name: Governance Role Coverage
metrics.definition: Percentage of critical data domains with a named, empowered Data Owner and Data Steward.
metrics.formula: (Critical domains with named owner + steward / Total critical domains) * 100

metrics.name: Access Request Fulfillment Time
metrics.definition: Median time from data access request to provisioned, policy-checked access (balancing Zero Trust with low friction).
metrics.formula: Median(provisioning timestamp - request timestamp) for policy-approved requests

metrics.name: Shadow Data Remediation Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of discovered unmanaged data stores (shadow copies, ungoverned exports) onboarded to governance or decommissioned within 60 days.
metrics.formula: (Shadow stores resolved <= 60 days / Total shadow stores discovered) * 100

metrics.name: Steward Response SLA Attainment
metrics.definition: Percentage of governance tickets (definitions, access, quality triage) resolved by stewards within their published SLA.
metrics.formula: (Governance tickets resolved within SLA / Total governance tickets) * 100

metrics.name: Data Ethics Board Independence Score
metrics.definition: Composite score measuring the structural independence, diversity, and authority of the Data/AI Ethics Board: external member ratio, reporting line independence (not to CDAO/CISO), meeting cadence, and veto power over high-risk deployments.
metrics.formula: 0.30*ExternalMemberRatio + 0.30*ReportingLineIndependence + 0.20*MeetingCadence + 0.20*VetoAuthority (each normalized 0-100)

metrics.name: Ethics & Data Whistleblower Channel Effectiveness
metrics.definition: Percentage of reported data ethics/privacy concerns via whistleblower channels that are acknowledged within 48 hours, investigated independently, and resolved with documented corrective action.
metrics.formula: (Concerns acknowledged <= 48h and resolved with corrective action / Total reported concerns) * 100
metrics.owner_role: Chief Compliance Officer with AI Ethics Board
metrics.measurement_method: Automated - whistleblower platform workflow + retaliation monitoring

data_supply_chain_security.description: NEW DOMAIN in v4.0.0. Governs the integrity, provenance, and security of data flowing through the supply chain, including third-party data providers, SaaS data exports, open datasets, and M&A data transfers. Applies SLSA-for-data principles.
data_supply_chain_security.domain_score_formula: Weighted mean of metric attainment (Tier weights T1=3, T2=2, T3=1), scaled 0-100.

metrics.name: Data SBOM (dSBOM) Coverage
metrics.definition: Percentage of ingested third-party and open datasets accompanied by a machine-readable Data Software Bill of Materials (dSBOM) documenting source, transformation history, license, and classification.
metrics.formula: (Ingested datasets with valid dSBOM / Total ingested third-party/open datasets) * 100

metrics.name: Third-Party Data Provider Risk Rating
metrics.definition: Percentage of active third-party data providers with a current (<= 12 months) security, privacy, and ethical risk assessment at or above acceptable threshold.
metrics.formula: (Providers with current acceptable risk rating / Total active providers) * 100
metrics.owner_role: Data Supply Chain Officer with TPRM
metrics.critical_threshold: < 95.0 or any provider rated unacceptable still active
metrics.measurement_method: Automated - TPRM platform + questionnaire + audit evidence

metrics.name: Data Pipeline Integrity Verification
metrics.definition: Percentage of data pipeline stages (ingestion, transformation, storage, consumption) with cryptographic attestation of artifact integrity (checksums, signed manifests) at each hop.
metrics.formula: (Pipeline stages with cryptographic attestation / Total pipeline stages) * 100

metrics.name: Cryptographic Agility & PQC Readiness
metrics.definition: Percentage of data supply chain cryptographic controls (signing, encryption, integrity checks) capable of algorithm swap within 30 days to respond to cryptographic vulnerabilities or PQC migration.
metrics.formula: (Crypto controls with documented swap capability / Total crypto controls in data supply chain) * 100
metrics.owner_role: CISO with Data Supply Chain Officer

metrics.name: Data Provenance Tamper-Evidence Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of critical data assets with tamper-evident provenance records (append-only ledgers, signed hashes, blockchain anchors) covering the full lifecycle.
metrics.formula: (Critical data assets with tamper-evident provenance / Total critical data assets) * 100

metrics.name: Supply Chain Vulnerability Remediation MTTR
metrics.definition: Mean time from disclosure of a data-supply-chain vulnerability (e.g., poisoned dataset, compromised provider, tainted model weight) to verified remediation or isolation.
metrics.formula: Sum(remediation time per supply chain vulnerability) / Total supply chain vulnerabilities
metrics.owner_role: Data Supply Chain Officer with CISO
metrics.critical_threshold: > 168 hours (critical) or any unremediated critical > 7 days

ecosystem_and_data_spaces.description: NEW DOMAIN in v4.0.0. Governs cross-organizational data exchange through data spaces, data trusts, and ecosystem partnerships, including identity federation, usage policy enforcement, and value exchange measurement.
ecosystem_and_data_spaces.domain_score_formula: Weighted mean of metric attainment (Tier weights T1=3, T2=2, T3=1), scaled 0-100.

metrics.name: Data Space Connector Conformance
metrics.definition: Percentage of ecosystem data exchanges conducted through certified data space connectors (Gaia-X Self-Descriptions, IDSA Connector, DSSC-compliant) with verifiable usage policies.
metrics.formula: (Exchanges via certified connectors / Total ecosystem exchanges) * 100

metrics.name: Cross-Organizational Interoperability Success
metrics.definition: Percentage of cross-organizational data exchanges completing end-to-end with semantic, syntactic, and legal interoperability verified (no manual intervention required).
metrics.formula: (Successful cross-org exchanges / Total cross-org exchange attempts) * 100

metrics.name: Data Trust Governance Maturity
metrics.definition: Maturity score of data trust arrangements (where data is held by an independent fiduciary for collective benefit), measuring trustee independence, beneficiary representation, purpose clarity, and CARE Principle adherence.
metrics.formula: 0.25*TrusteeIndependence + 0.25*BeneficiaryRepresentation + 0.25*PurposeClarity + 0.25*CAREAdherence (each 0-100)
metrics.owner_role: Data Trust Board / Ecosystem Integration Lead

metrics.name: Ecosystem Value Exchange Volume
metrics.definition: Aggregate quantified value (revenue, cost avoidance, societal benefit) generated through ecosystem data exchanges, year-over-year growth.
metrics.formula: Sum of quantified value from ecosystem data exchanges (current year) vs. prior year

metrics.name: Federated Identity & Attribute Assertion Accuracy
metrics.definition: Percentage of cross-organizational attribute assertions (verifiable credentials, SAML assertions, OIDC claims) that are accurate, current, and revocable within 1 hour of status change.
metrics.formula: (Accurate + current + revocable assertions / Total cross-org assertions) * 100
metrics.critical_threshold: < 97.0 or any stale assertion leading to unauthorized access

test_data_management.description: NEW DOMAIN in v4.0.0. Governs the creation, subsetting, masking, synthetic generation, and isolation of test data, ensuring production-like fidelity without privacy, security, or compliance risk.
test_data_management.domain_score_formula: Weighted mean of metric attainment (Tier weights T1=3, T2=2, T3=1), scaled 0-100.

metrics.name: Production-Like Test Data Fidelity
metrics.definition: Percentage of test data sets meeting contracted fidelity requirements (schema, referential integrity, business rule conformance, distributional similarity) for their intended test purpose.
metrics.formula: (Test data sets meeting fidelity requirements / Total test data sets) * 100

metrics.name: Test Data PII Leakage Rate
metrics.definition: Number of confirmed PII leakage incidents from test environments per 10,000 test data records generated or provisioned.
metrics.formula: (PII leakage incidents from test environments / Total test data records provisioned) * 10000
metrics.critical_threshold: Any incident involving > 100 records or special-category data
metrics.measurement_method: Automated - DSPM scanning of test environments + incident register

metrics.name: Test Data Refresh Latency
metrics.definition: Median time from production data change to corresponding test data refresh (for tests requiring current production-like data).
metrics.formula: Median(test data refresh timestamp - production change timestamp)

metrics.name: Synthetic Test Data Statistical Parity
metrics.definition: Percentage of synthetic test data sets achieving statistical parity (distribution, correlation, cardinality) with production data within contracted tolerance, without PII leakage.
metrics.formula: (Synthetic data sets within statistical tolerance / Total synthetic data sets) * 100
metrics.owner_role: Test Data Manager with Data Science
metrics.measurement_method: Automated - statistical parity test suite + privacy leakage test

metrics.name: Test Environment Isolation Verification
metrics.definition: Percentage of test environments with verified network, data, and identity isolation from production, preventing accidental data leakage or production impact.
metrics.formula: (Test environments passing isolation verification / Total test environments) * 100
metrics.measurement_method: Automated - network segmentation scan + access control audit

vector_and_embedding_quality.description: NEW DOMAIN in v4.0.0. Governs the quality, freshness, drift, and relevance of vector embeddings and vector stores used for RAG, semantic search, and similarity-based AI applications.
vector_and_embedding_quality.domain_score_formula: Weighted mean of metric attainment (Tier weights T1=3, T2=2, T3=1), scaled 0-100.

metrics.name: Embedding Drift Index
metrics.definition: Percentage of vector stores with embedding distributions within contracted drift tolerance of the baseline (measured via KL divergence, MMD, or similar).
metrics.formula: (Vector stores within drift tolerance / Total vector stores) * 100
metrics.owner_role: MLOps Lead with Head of Data Science

metrics.name: Retrieval Relevance Score (NDCG@k)
metrics.definition: Mean Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain at k (NDCG@k) for retrieval-augmented queries against a curated evaluation set.
metrics.formula: Mean(NDCG@k) across evaluation queries

metrics.name: Vector Index Freshness
metrics.definition: Percentage of vector index entries reflecting source data changes within contracted freshness SLA.
metrics.formula: (Vector entries within freshness SLA / Total vector entries) * 100

metrics.name: Semantic Deduplication Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of near-duplicate vectors (cosine similarity > threshold) identified and merged or removed from vector stores.
metrics.formula: (Near-duplicate vectors resolved / Total near-duplicate vectors detected) * 100

metrics.name: Cross-Lingual Embedding Parity
metrics.definition: For multilingual vector stores, percentage of languages achieving retrieval performance within 10% of the primary language baseline.
metrics.formula: (Languages within 10% of primary language NDCG / Total supported languages) * 100

digital_twins_and_simulation_data.description: NEW DOMAIN in v4.0.0. Governs data quality, synchronization, fidelity, and scenario integrity for digital twins and simulation data used in manufacturing, smart cities, healthcare, and other physical-digital convergence domains.
digital_twins_and_simulation_data.domain_score_formula: Weighted mean of metric attainment (Tier weights T1=3, T2=2, T3=1), scaled 0-100.

metrics.name: Twin-to-Physical Synchronization Lag
metrics.definition: Median time for physical-world state changes to be reflected in the digital twin, critical for safety and operational twins.
metrics.formula: Median(twin update timestamp - physical event timestamp)
metrics.critical_threshold: > 5000 ms or any safety-critical twin exceeding 100 ms

metrics.name: Simulation Fidelity Validation Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of simulation models with validated fidelity against physical-world ground truth within contracted tolerance.
metrics.formula: (Simulation models passing fidelity validation / Total simulation models) * 100
metrics.owner_role: Digital Twin Steward with Data Science

metrics.name: Scenario Data Integrity
metrics.definition: Percentage of simulation scenarios with complete, versioned, tamper-evident input data, parameters, and initial conditions.
metrics.formula: (Scenarios with complete versioned integrity / Total scenarios) * 100

metrics.name: Twin Model Version Consistency
metrics.definition: Percentage of digital twin instances running the approved, current model version, with no shadow or deprecated versions in production.
metrics.formula: (Twin instances on approved model version / Total twin instances) * 100

metric_attainment_score.description: Normalized 0-110 attainment per metric, capped at 110 to reward over-performance without masking other failures.

rules.higher_is_better: MAS = min(actual / target * 100, 110); if target = 100 and actual = 100, MAS = 110 (perfection bonus capped).
rules.lower_is_better: MAS = min(target / actual * 100, 110) for actual > 0; MAS = 110 if actual = 0.
rules.band: MAS = 100 while inside band; 0 outside band; interpolated for near-miss warnings.

global_data_excellence_index.formula: Sum(domain score * domain weight) / Sum(weights), scaled 0-100.
global_data_excellence_index.hard_override: Any ES4 breach or critical threshold breach on a Tier 1 metric caps the reported GDEI at 84.9 until remediation is verified.

data_supply_chain_resilience_index.description: NEW composite index in v4.0.0. Measures end-to-end resilience of the data supply chain.
data_supply_chain_resilience_index.formula: Weighted mean of DSC domain metrics (DSC-01 to DSC-06) + DSP-04 (encryption) + DSP-10 (cross-border) + DCO-01 (contract coverage) + DQO-03 (lineage), scaled 0-100.
data_supply_chain_resilience_index.hard_override: DSCRI < 70.0 caps GDEI at 84.9 regardless of other scores.

ai_trustworthiness_index.description: NEW composite index in v4.0.0. Measures trustworthiness of AI systems across the lifecycle.
ai_trustworthiness_index.formula: Weighted mean of AAG + GEN domain metrics, scaled 0-100.
ai_trustworthiness_index.hard_override: AITI < 80.0 prohibits deployment of high-risk AI systems per EU AI Act.

ecosystem_interoperability_score.description: NEW composite index in v4.0.0. Measures ecosystem-level data exchange maturity.
ecosystem_interoperability_score.formula: Weighted mean of ECO domain metrics + MET-07/08 + MDM-06, scaled 0-100.
ecosystem_interoperability_score.target: >= 80.0 for organizations with significant ecosystem data exchange
ecosystem_interoperability_score.hard_override: None, but EIS < 60.0 triggers strategic review.

cross_domain_metric_dependencies.rationale: Blast radius containment requires end-to-end lineage.
KPI consistency requires governed semantic definitions.
Groundedness depends on provenance-tracked, classified corpus with fresh vector index.
Commercial SLAs are bounded by reliability SLOs and freshness.
ROT elimination must respect retention and minimization rules.
Contracts require cataloged assets and named owners.
Pipeline integrity verification requires tamper-evident provenance.
Cross-org interoperability requires connector conformance and federated identity.
PII leakage detection requires accurate classification.
Retrieval relevance depends on provenanced corpus and fresh index.
Twin sync lag requires streaming data integrity.
Agent-to-agent contracts extend data contract patterns.
Cascade containment requires lineage and breaking change compliance.
Purpose limitation requires granular consent tracking.

implementation_and_governance.description: Operational guidelines, maturity model, decision rights, and enforcement mechanisms for adopting the Global Data Standard Metrics.

maturity_levels.name: Initial (Ad-hoc)
maturity_levels.description: Metrics unmeasured, manual, or sporadic. No centralized governance.

maturity_levels.name: Managed (Reactive)
maturity_levels.description: Metrics defined and documented; basic tooling; tracking largely manual and reactive.

maturity_levels.name: Defined (Proactive)
maturity_levels.description: Automated tracking, organization-wide standards, clear ownership (Stewards/Owners), integrated dashboards.

maturity_levels.name: Quantitatively Managed (Predictive)
maturity_levels.description: Metrics in CI/CD (DataOps). Predictive analytics forecast quality, cost, and security issues before they occur.

maturity_levels.name: Optimizing (Autonomous)
maturity_levels.description: AI-driven, self-healing ecosystem. Autonomous agents remediate quality, security, reliability, and cost anomalies in real time with human oversight of boundaries.

roles_and_responsibilities.Chief Data Officer (CDO) / CDAO: Ultimate accountability for data strategy, governance, and Tier 1 metric compliance.
roles_and_responsibilities.Data Product Owners: End-to-end lifecycle, SLAs, adoption, and RODA of data products (Data Mesh paradigm).
roles_and_responsibilities.Data Stewards: Operational ownership of quality, metadata, classification, and domain metric thresholds.
roles_and_responsibilities.Data Engineering / Platform Teams: Automated metric collection, lineage, pipeline reliability, and cost optimization.
roles_and_responsibilities.Data Reliability Lead (SRE for Data): SLOs, error budgets, incident command, postmortem learning, and cascade containment.
roles_and_responsibilities.MDM Lead: Golden records, survivorship rules, reference data integrity.
roles_and_responsibilities.Records & Retention Officer: Retention schedules, legal holds, defensible disposition.
roles_and_responsibilities.FinOps Lead: Unit economics, utilization, and cost attribution metrics.
roles_and_responsibilities.Green Data / Sustainability Lead: Carbon, energy, water, and e-waste metrics; SBTi alignment.
roles_and_responsibilities.AI Ethics & Governance Board: Algorithmic fairness, provenance, explainability, autonomy boundaries, GenAI grounding, multi-agent safety.
roles_and_responsibilities.CISO / CPO: Security, encryption, Zero Trust, privacy, residency, breach response, PQC readiness, cross-border transfers.
roles_and_responsibilities.Data Experience Lead: Visualization truthfulness, accessibility (including neurodiverse), and usability metrics.
roles_and_responsibilities.Metadata Lead: Catalog coverage, metadata freshness, and machine-readable conformance.
roles_and_responsibilities.Data Supply Chain Officer (NEW): End-to-end data supply chain integrity, dSBOM, third-party risk, cryptographic attestation.
roles_and_responsibilities.Ecosystem Integration Lead (NEW): Data space conformance, cross-organizational interoperability, federated identity, data trust governance.
roles_and_responsibilities.Test Data Manager (NEW): Test data fidelity, privacy, freshness, synthetic parity, environment isolation.
roles_and_responsibilities.Digital Twin Steward (NEW): Twin synchronization, simulation fidelity, scenario integrity, model version consistency.
roles_and_responsibilities.AI Security Lead (NEW): Adversarial robustness, prompt-injection defense, agent tool-use boundaries, AI red-teaming.
roles_and_responsibilities.Chief Compliance Officer: Whistleblower channels, regulatory change management, cross-jurisdictional compliance.
roles_and_responsibilities.Data Ethics Board Chair: Board independence, ethical review, veto authority over high-risk AI.

raci_matrix.legend: R = Responsible, A = Accountable, C = Consulted, I = Informed

escalation_matrix.trigger: Metric within tolerance but trending adversely

escalation_matrix.response_sla: Containment <= 72 hours; root-cause report <= 10 business days

escalation_matrix.trigger: Breach with legal or regulatory exposure
escalation_matrix.notification: CISO/CPO + General Counsel immediately; Board <= 72 hours
escalation_matrix.response_sla: Statutory clocks honored; incident commander appointed immediately

decision_cadence.daily: Automated ES2/ES3 alert triage by stewards and reliability leads.
decision_cadence.monthly: Data Governance Council: all Tier 1 and Tier 2 dashboards, breach reviews, threshold change requests.
decision_cadence.quarterly: Board-level GDEI report; domain weight review; maturity progression assessment; DSCRI/AITI/EIS review.
decision_cadence.semi_annual: Full standard review; metric lifecycle decisions (propose/deprecate); conformance profile updates; AI Ethics Board independence assessment.
decision_cadence.annual: Certification audit; Data Ethics Board composition review; whistleblower channel effectiveness review; regulatory horizon scanning.

meta_governance_of_metrics.description: The metrics system is itself measured to prevent erosion and gaming.

meta_metrics.name: Metric Definition Version Compliance
meta_metrics.target: 100% of active metrics versioned with change logs

meta_metrics.name: Threshold Change Governance
meta_metrics.target: 100% of threshold/formula changes approved via council with immutable audit trail

meta_metrics.name: Regulatory Horizon Scanning Coverage
meta_metrics.target: 100% of jurisdictions of operation scanned quarterly for data/AI regulatory changes

meta_metrics.name: Metric Pipeline Observability
meta_metrics.target: 100% of metric collection pipelines themselves monitored for freshness and completeness

continuous_improvement_cycle: Define: Establish baseline metrics, thresholds, SLAs/SLOs aligned to business and regulatory goals; version definitions.
Measure: Automate collection via observability, cataloging, and monitoring (OpenTelemetry, OpenLineage); verify MMA-01.
Analyze: Review dashboards and breach alerts in monthly council; apply cross-domain dependency analysis.
Improve: Root-cause analysis (5 Whys) and automated remediation workflows; validate via DRI-06 recurring-incident rate.
Control (new): Lock in gains via policy-as-code, contract gates, and annual audit evidence refresh.
Anticipate (new): Quarterly regulatory horizon scanning (MMA-04) feeds proactive metric/threshold evolution.

adoption_quickstart.phase_1_days_0_90: Assign owners (DLC-02); inventory critical data products; stand up Tier 1 metric collection for DQO, DSP, DRI, DSC.
adoption_quickstart.phase_2_days_91_180: Extend automation to Tier 2; deploy escalation matrix; first GDEI baseline report; establish AI Ethics Board with independence baseline (DLC-06).
adoption_quickstart.phase_3_days_181_365: All domains instrumented; contract coverage (DCO-01) >= 75%; DSCRI baseline; Level I certification readiness assessment.
adoption_quickstart.phase_4_days_366_540: Ecosystem integration (ECO) operationalized; multi-agent governance (GEN-07/08) enforced; Level II certification target.

certification_and_audit.description: Mechanisms for internal and external validation of adherence to this standard, with tiered certification and explicit evidence requirements.

audit_mechanisms.description: Real-time policy-as-code checks (Open Policy Agent, contract gates) validating security, quality, contracts, metadata, and supply chain metrics at pipeline runtime.
Cross-functional governance board reviews maturity progression, GDEI, DSCRI, AITI, value realization, and ethical compliance.
Annual independent audit against ISO 8000, ISO 27001/42001, and this standard's domain metrics.
Periodic red-team of AI systems (MITRE ATLAS / OWASP LLM) and data exfiltration scenarios feeding GEN, AAG, and DSP metrics.
Annual third-party audit of data supply chain integrity, dSBOM accuracy, and provider risk ratings (DSC domain).
Bi-annual assessment of data space connector conformance and cross-org exchange success (ECO domain).

certification_tiers.requirements: All Tier 1 metrics at target for 2 consecutive quarters; maturity >= 3.0; continuous audit active; zero ES4 breaches; DSCRI >= 75.
Tier 1 + Tier 2 at target; GDEI >= 85; DSCRI >= 85; AITI >= 85; maturity >= 4.0; GDEI hard-override not triggered.
All metrics at target; GDEI >= 95; DSCRI >= 90; AITI >= 90; maturity >= 4.5; demonstrated autonomous remediation with human-boundary controls (GEN-04 = 100%).
certification_tiers.validity: 24 months with surveillance audit at 12 months

certification_tiers.requirements: Level III maintained 2 years; public transparency report; independent AI red-team passed; zero regulatory findings in period; EIS >= 85 for ecosystem-active organizations.
Level IV maintained 2 years; active leadership in at least one recognized data space (Gaia-X/IDSA); published data trust or data philanthropy initiative; EIS >= 95.

evidence_requirements: Immutable metric collection logs and lineage graphs (OpenLineage exports)
Policy-as-code repository with change history (OPA bundles, contract definitions)
Incident register with MTTD/MTTR timestamps and postmortems
DPIA/consent registry and RTBF fulfillment records
Model registry with model cards, provenance ledgers, and fairness evaluation artifacts
Third-party penetration test and AI red-team reports
GDEI computation workbook with per-metric attainment audit trail
Data SBOM (dSBOM) registry with cryptographic attestation (NEW)
Third-party data provider risk assessment archive (NEW)
AI Ethics Board composition, meeting minutes, and veto decisions log (NEW)
Whistleblower case register with anonymized outcomes (NEW)
PQC migration roadmap and crypto-asset inventory (NEW)
Test data privacy impact assessments and isolation verification reports (NEW)

anti_gaming_provisions: No metric definition, formula, or threshold may be altered to mask an actual or anticipated breach; all changes require council approval with version history (MMA-03).
Sampling methodologies must be documented, statistically valid, and free of discretionary sample selection.
Over-performance caps (MAS max 110) prevent single-metric distortion of domain scores.
Value claims require auditable attribution (DMV-07) before inclusion in RODA or board reporting.
Automated collection is preferred; manual attestation metrics require dual sign-off and are flagged in GDEI reporting.
Metric pipelines themselves are monitored (meta-observability); collection outages do not pause SLA clocks.
Synthetic data and test data metrics cannot be satisfied with production data leakage (TDM-02 is zero-tolerance).
AI Ethics Board independence (DLC-06) is audited externally; self-reported scores are not accepted.
Ecosystem value claims (ECO-04) require counter-party attestation.
Supply chain integrity metrics (DSC) cannot be satisfied by self-attestation of providers; independent audit evidence required for Tier 1.

glossary.definition: Data element whose failure materially impacts regulatory, financial, or safety outcomes.
A managed, discoverable data asset with an owner, SLAs, contracts, and consumers.
Machine-enforceable agreement specifying schema, quality, SLA, semantics, and ownership between producer and consumers.
Global Data Excellence Index; the weighted composite score of all domain scores (0-100).
Data Supply Chain Resilience Index; composite measuring end-to-end data supply chain integrity.
AI Trustworthiness Index; composite measuring trustworthiness of AI systems across the lifecycle.
Ecosystem Interoperability Score; composite measuring ecosystem-level data exchange maturity.
Metric Attainment Score; normalized 0-110 attainment of a single metric against target.
Return on Data Asset; net benefit of a data asset relative to total cost of ownership.
The single authoritative master record for an entity after match, merge, and survivorship.
Redundant, Obsolete, or Trivial data eligible for archival or deletion.
The tolerable amount of SLO shortfall that funds innovation velocity (SRE model).
The set of downstream consumers impacted by a data failure.
The degree to which generative AI output is verifiably supported by approved sources.
Rules determining which source values win when merging records into a golden record.
Data stores or AI tools handling enterprise data outside governed channels.
Tamper-evident record of who/what handled data at each lifecycle event.
Tiered notification and response protocol attached to every metric threshold.
Collective Benefit, Authority to Control, Responsibility, Ethics - Indigenous data governance complement to FAIR.
Rule capping GDEI after critical Tier-1 breaches regardless of composite score.
Data Software Bill of Materials; machine-readable manifest documenting data source, transformation history, license, and classification.
A governed ecosystem for decentralized data sharing based on trust, interoperability, and sovereignty (e.g., Gaia-X, IDSA).
A legal structure where an independent trustee manages data on behalf of beneficiaries for collective benefit.
Cryptographic algorithms designed to be secure against both classical and quantum computer attacks (NIST FIPS 203/204/205).
The ability to swap cryptographic algorithms quickly in response to vulnerabilities or migration requirements.
A system of multiple autonomous AI agents collaborating through explicit contracts and orchestration.
Machine-enforceable agreement specifying allowed roles, message schemas, and delegation boundaries between AI agents.
The approved set of tools (APIs, code execution, file operations) an AI agent may invoke.
A digital representation of a physical entity or system, synchronized via data, used for simulation and decision-making.
A machine learning technique where models are trained across multiple decentralized devices or servers holding local data, without exchanging the data itself.
A tamper-evident digital credential whose authenticity can be cryptographically verified (W3C standard).
Design practices ensuring data visualizations and interfaces are usable by people with cognitive and neurological differences (e.g., ADHD, autism, dyslexia).
A failure in an upstream data component that propagates to downstream consumers, potentially causing system-wide impact.
Resilience patterns that contain failures and prevent cascade propagation in data architectures.
Unauthorized use of data for purposes beyond those originally declared and consented.
A protected reporting mechanism for data ethics, privacy, and security concerns, compliant with EU Whistleblower Directive.

regulatory_horizon_mapping.description: Mapping of key regulatory regimes to primary metrics for compliance tracking.

changes: Expanded from 13 to 18 domains and from 79 to 119 metrics.
Added 5 new domains: Data Supply Chain Security (DSC), Ecosystem & Data Spaces (ECO), Test Data Management (TDM), Vector & Embedding Quality (VEC), Digital Twins & Simulation Data (DTW).

Added 40 new metrics across all domains, including PQC readiness (DSP-08), consent granularity (DSP-09), cross-border transfers (DSP-10), federated learning (AAG-08), adversarial robustness (AAG-09), multi-agent orchestration (GEN-07/08), agent memory governance (GEN-09), data portability (DMV-08, DLR-06), purpose limitation (DLR-07), cascade failure containment (DRI-07), contract backward compatibility (DCO-07), ethics board independence (DLC-06), whistleblower effectiveness (DLC-07), dSBOM coverage (DSC-01), data space conformance (ECO-01/02), and more.
Introduced 3 new composite indexes: Data Supply Chain Resilience Index (DSCRI), AI Trustworthiness Index (AITI), Ecosystem Interoperability Score (EIS).
Added 4 new sector conformance profiles: Energy & Utilities, Telecommunications, Defense & Aerospace, Transportation & Logistics.

Introduced 5 new cross-cutting principles: Data Supply Chain Integrity, Quantum-Readiness & Cryptographic Agility, Ecosystem-Level Interoperability, Cognitive & Neurodiverse Accessibility, Multi-Agent Safety & Boundary Control.
Added Level V - Ecosystem Leader certification tier.

Expanded roles with 7 new specialized roles: Data Supply Chain Officer, Ecosystem Integration Lead, Test Data Manager, Digital Twin Steward, AI Security Lead, Chief Compliance Officer, Data Ethics Board Chair.
Added regulatory horizon mapping for EU AI Act, GDPR, EU Data Act, China PIPL, India DPDP Act, Brazil LGPD, NIST PQC FIPS, EU Whistleblower Directive, NERC CIP, HIPAA/HITRUST.

Extended framework alignment with 25+ new standards including NIST FIPS 203/204/205, SLSA-for-data, Gaia-X, IDSA, DSSC, W3C DID/VC, ISO 23247, ISO 20917, Science Based Targets, CDP Water Security, OWASP LLM v1.5, and more.
Added new evidence requirements for certification: dSBOM registry, PQC roadmap, AI Ethics Board minutes, whistleblower case register, test data privacy assessments, digital twin fidelity reports.
Enhanced anti-gaming provisions with 5 new clauses covering synthetic data, ethics board independence, ecosystem value claims, supply chain self-attestation, and test data leakage.
Expanded glossary with 20 new terms covering data spaces, PQC, multi-agent systems, digital twins, federated learning, neurodiverse accessibility, cascade failure, and more.
Added adoption quickstart Phase 4 (days 366-540) for ecosystem integration and multi-agent governance.
Added new meta-governance metrics MMA-04 (regulatory horizon scanning) and MMA-05 (metric pipeline observability).
Introduced quantum_readiness_tag and ecosystem_scope as optional metric fields.
Added regulatory_horizon_mapping section for compliance tracking across jurisdictions.
Introduced canonical metric schema; expanded to 13 domains and 79 metrics; added GDEI composite scoring; added certification tiers I-IV; added RACI matrix and escalation matrix.
Baseline seven-domain structure with 20 foundational metrics.
